thread:
Marta (Partnerships): Heads-up — kicking off coordination with Nimbus for a new eu-southwest region (eu-sw2). Partner requests initial reserved capacity + burst plan, marketplace listing, KMS, and legal intake. Tentative go-live in ~3 weeks. I’ll own partner comms. Spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/nimbus-eu-sw2

Omar (Cloud Ops): Can you confirm exact GPU SKUs, vCPU and RAM counts? Also do we want a per-tenant nodepool or shared pooled nodes?

Marta (Partnerships): Partner proposes 4xA100 nodes initially, burst to 8 for first 2 weeks. Each pod ~16 vCPU / 512GB RAM. Shared nodepool with tenant isolation via vhosts. Lina, feasible on your side?

Lina (Nimbus Ops): We can allocate 4 A100 now and enable burst to 8 after entitlement is confirmed. Need vendor marketplace ID and legal onboarding to turn on reserved capacity. SLA requested: 99.9% — can confirm?

Omar (Cloud Ops): 99.9% is workable for dedicated pools. I’ll need exact marketplace SKU IDs and the target project IDs to open quota requests. Lucas, can you enumerate the SKU ids we’ll expose?

Lucas (Marketplace): I can draft the listing. Need partner-provided logo, 50-word blurb, and the SKU mapping (billing path: partner-billed vs marketplace-billed). Partner-billed preferred for commit pricing.

Sree (Infra): For private/VPC and peering: we’ll need CIDR ranges, egress IP list, and KMS key ARN if partner is using customer-managed keys. Also share kernel/driver patch windows — we need a rolling update plan.

Dalia (Legal): We’ll require DPA + security questionnaire. Partner must provide SOC2 or ISO attestation. Legal intake typically adds ~5 business days. I’ll start the intake now.

Marta (Partnerships): ACTIONS (owner / ETA):
- Lina (Nimbus): confirm SKU ids & vendor billing model — EOD Tue
- Omar (Cloud Ops): open quota ticket with SKUs + project IDs — ETA Wed
- Sree (Infra): preflight checklist + peering template — ETA Fri
- Lucas (Marketplace): draft listing + publish flow doc — ETA Wed
- Dalia (Legal): intake + DPA kickoff — ETA next Tue

PartnerBot: Provision request req-78234 submitted to Nimbus. Status: pending vendor approval :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Lina (Nimbus Ops): Noted. Will share SKUs and vendor flow by EOD. Also need Redwood billing contact for commit paperwork.

Marta (Partnerships): Looping in Finance separately. Also planning a small joint announcement day-of-launch (no big press). Lucas, hold public comms until SLA/marketplace live?

Lucas (Marketplace): Hold confirmed. I’ll prepare a comms kit: sample tweet, docs snippet, and partner blog template.

Omar (Cloud Ops): Opening quota ticket now: https://cloudprovider.example/quotas/REQ-5491 — I’ll attach the SKU list when Lina shares.

Sree (Infra): Adding CIDR & peering template to the shared spreadsheet. Will include a sample BGP snippet and required firewall rules.

Dalia (Legal): Intake form submitted; partner needs to fill security form here: https://forms.redwood/legal-intake — once we get attestation we can clear DPA.

Lina (Nimbus Ops): We aim to provision vendor-side reserved capacity within 6 business days after paperwork completes.

Marta (Partnerships): Great — daily sync for this sprint at 9am PT starting tomorrow to surface blockers. If anything blocks earlier, ping me or drop updates here. :bolt:

Omar (Cloud Ops): will do.

Lucas (Marketplace): thumbs up :thumbsup:

Marta (Partnerships): Thanks all — letting partner know we have owners and timeline. Lina, please add the billing contact and preferred SLA doc to the sheet when you can.

Lina (Nimbus Ops): Will add billing contact and SLA doc tonight.

PartnerBot: Reminder — vendor approval pending. Status update will post automatically.
